# MenuMinute

> MenuMinute helps restaurants create free digital menus with permanent QR codes, guest ordering, cashier POS and Kitchen Pro. Public restaurant menus are open to search engines and AI assistants.

- [Home](https://food.bababuilds.com/)

## Restaurant menus
Every published restaurant menu is listed in the [sitemap](https://food.bababuilds.com/sitemap.xml) at `/m/<menu-id>`.
